name: Jordan Lee
bio:
Jordan Lee is a results-oriented operations manager with a talent for optimizing business processes and improving operational efficiency. With extensive experience in operations management, supply chain optimization, and process improvement, Jordan ensures that Code Collider's projects run smoothly and deliver exceptional value to clients.

Jordan's expertise includes Lean Six Sigma methodologies, resource planning, and quality management. They have successfully implemented operational improvements that have resulted in significant cost reductions and productivity gains for multiple organizations. Jordan is a certified Six Sigma Black Belt and holds a degree in Industrial Engineering.

Outside of work, Jordan is passionate about sustainable business practices and volunteers with local organizations focused on environmental conservation.
